projectDescription: Script.it is an AI-powered automation platform that lets you describe workflows in plain English and instantly build, run, and schedule them against 600+ integrations.
keyFeatures: Conversational AI agent builds and edits automation workflows from plain-English prompts
Reusable scripts with ordered steps that users can review, run, and refine
600+ prebuilt integrations (Slack, Gmail, Notion, HubSpot, and more)
Schedule triggers and webhook triggers for automated runs
Isolated run environment per session with file management
Real-time progress updates and block execution results
Developer reference for script files, advanced script format, runtime details, and trigger payloads
Template library for common use cases (SEO blog, weekly reports, competitor research)
Usage-based credits with optional spend limits and Stripe billing
publicApiSurface: Agent chat for building and editing scripts
Live session updates while the agent works
Trigger management for schedules, webhooks, and integration events
Billing checkout and credit balance views
Webhook URLs for starting scripts from external services
